# A raise follows the render tree: a handler in a component that reaches no
# boundary in its own body is caught by the boundary around the instance that
# raised, however many instantiations up, and each instance answers to its own.
#
# The checker resolves a raise inside the component it was written in, so
# before passErrorScope every compiled target let such a raise out of the click
# uncaught, and the interpreter reported `raised: empty` for all of these.
# The interpreter follows the tree at run time (the frames a node is mounted
# under), and a compiled target resolves each spliced instance statically.
#
# The emitted-event case is the other direction: listener's @pick runs inside
# emitter's click -- a compiled target inlines it there -- so the boundary
# catching its raise ends the click too.
#
# Only the interpreter runs these: no compiled test agent reaches an element
# through a nested instance (`c.l.go`) -- bubbletea's reads it as a Model field
# `lGo` and does not compile, and html's fails the click. What those targets
# emit is testdata/error_raise_render_tree.txtar.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '5 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

func check(s string) {
    if s.length == 0 {
        error.raise("empty", "validation")
    }
}

component leaf node {
    var after = false
    vbox {
        button #go(text="go", @click {
            check("")
            after = true
        })
        button #raw(text="raw", @click {
            error.raise("direct", "validation")
            after = true
        })
    }
}

component middle node {
    leaf #l()
}

component oneDeep node {
    var problem = "none"
    boundary(@error(e) {
        problem = "caught: " + e.message
    }) {
        leaf #l()
    }
}

func testComponentUnderBoundary(t Test, c oneDeep) {
    c.l.go.click()
    t.assert(c.problem == "caught: empty")
    t.assert(c.l.after == false)
    c.l.raw.click()
    t.assert(c.problem == "caught: direct")
    t.assert(c.l.after == false)
}

component twoDeep node {
    var problem = "none"
    boundary(@error(e) {
        problem = e.message
    }) {
        middle #m()
    }
}

func testComponentTwoLevelsDown(t Test, c twoDeep) {
    c.m.l.go.click()
    t.assert(c.problem == "empty")
}

component nearest node {
    var inner = "none"
    var outer = "none"
    boundary(@error(e) {
        outer = e.message
    }) {
        vbox {
            boundary(@error(e) {
                inner = e.message
            }) {
                leaf #a()
            }
            leaf #b()
        }
    }
}

func testEachInstanceReachesItsOwnBoundary(t Test, c nearest) {
    c.a.go.click()
    t.assert(c.inner == "empty")
    t.assert(c.outer == "none")
    c.b.go.click()
    t.assert(c.outer == "empty")
}

component rethrow node {
    var inner = "none"
    var outer = "none"
    boundary(@error(e) {
        outer = e.message
    }) {
        boundary(@error(e) {
            inner = e.message
            error.raise("again", "validation")
        }) {
            leaf #l()
        }
    }
}

func testBoundaryHandlerRaisesOutward(t Test, c rethrow) {
    c.l.go.click()
    t.assert(c.inner == "empty")
    t.assert(c.outer == "again")
}

component emitter(@pick()) node {
    var after = false
    button #go(text="go", @click {
        pick()
        after = true
    })
}

component listener node {
    var problem = "none"
    boundary(@error(e) {
        problem = e.message
    }) {
        emitter #c(@pick {
            check("")
        })
    }
}

func testRaiseInEmittedHandlerEndsTheEmitter(t Test, c listener) {
    c.c.go.click()
    t.assert(c.problem == "empty")
    t.assert(c.c.after == false)
}

window {
    oneDeep()
}
